Sync windows (a published release waits for Argo CD while one is closed)

Handover, when this estate is live (apply will write it as handover.sh; plan runs nothing)
  1. delete each ApplicationSet (apptique, checkout-cache, platform-addons) with 'kubectl delete --cascade=orphan', so its Applications stay
  2. hand each Application to its variant under the same name, so Argo CD's tracking ID does not change and only the source moves to the ConfigHub gateway
  3. never delete root, storefront: resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io deletes everything it deployed
  4. AppProject platform allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples: add the ConfigHub gateway's oci:// address to sourceRepos first
  5. AppProject storefront allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples: add the ConfigHub gateway's oci:// address to sourceRepos first
